8.3.26 CanIf_EnableBusMirroring
[SWS_CANIF_91005] Definition of API function CanIf_EnableBusMirroring ⌈
Service Name
CanIf_EnableBusMirroring
Syntax
Std_ReturnType CanIf_EnableBusMirroring (
uint8 ControllerId,
boolean MirroringActive
)
Service ID [hex]
0x4c
Sync/Async
Synchronous
Reentrancy
Reentrant
ControllerId
Abstracted CanIf ControllerId which is assigned to a CAN
controller.
Parameters (in)
MirroringActive
TRUE: Mirror_ReportCanFrame will be called for each frame
received or transmitted on the given controller. FALSE: Mirror_
ReportCanFrame will not be called for the given controller.
Parameters (inout)
None
Parameters (out)
None
Return value
Std_ReturnType
E_OK: Mirroring mode was changed.
E_NOT_OK: Wrong ControllerId, or mirroring globally disabled
(see CanIfBusMirroringSupport).
Description
Enables or disables mirroring for a CAN controller.
Available via
CanIf.h
⌋
[SWS_CANIF_00911]
Upstream requirements: SRS_Can_01172
⌈If Bus Mirroring is not enabled (see CanIfBusMirroringSupport), the API
CanIf_EnableBusMirroring() can be omitted.⌋
[SWS_CANIF_00912]
Upstream requirements: SRS_BSW_00323
⌈If parameter ControllerId of CanIf_EnableBusMirroring() has an invalid
value, the CanIf shall report development error code CANIF_E_PARAM_CONTROL-
LERID to the Det_ReportError service of the DET, when CanIf_EnableBusMir-
roring() is called.⌋
